claims.claim: gws gmail helper commands include +send, +reply, +reply-all, +forward, +triage and +watch. Documented in the CLI README (https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli/blob/main/README.md).
claims.raw_snippet:
| `gmail` | `+send` | Send an email |
| `gmail` | `+reply` | Reply to a message (handles threading automatically) |
| `gmail` | `+reply-all` | Reply-all to a message |
| `gmail` | `+forward` | Forward a message to new recipients |

claims.claim: gws gmail +send accepts --to, --subject, --body, --from, --attach (-a), --cc, --bcc, --html, --dry-run and --draft. Canonical skill file: https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli/blob/main/skills/gws-gmail-send/SKILL.md
claims.raw_snippet:
| `--dry-run` | — | — | Show the request that would be sent without executing it |
| `--draft` | — | — | Save as draft instead of sending |

claims.claim: gws gmail +send supports file attachments via -a/--attach, repeatable, 25MB total.
claims.raw_snippet: - Use -a/--attach to add file attachments. Can be specified multiple times. Total size limit: 25MB.

claims.claim: gws gmail +triage shows an unread inbox summary (sender, subject, date) and accepts --max, --query and --labels. Canonical skill file: https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli/blob/main/skills/gws-gmail-triage/SKILL.md
claims.raw_snippet: | `gmail` | `+triage` | Show unread inbox summary (sender, subject, date) |
claims.note: The canonical per-command file at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googleworkspace/cli/main/skills/gws-gmail-triage/SKILL.md carries the same description line plus the --max/--query/--labels flag table, but is too short for the gate's page-size heuristic, so the README table row is cited instead.

claims.claim: gws gmail +watch streams new emails as NDJSON and filters by Gmail label IDs (--label-ids), using Pub/Sub resources in a GCP project. Canonical skill file: https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli/blob/main/skills/gws-gmail-watch/SKILL.md
claims.raw_snippet: | `--label-ids` | — | — | Comma-separated Gmail label IDs to filter (e.g., INBOX,UNREAD) |

claims.claim: Gmail API usage limits were updated as of May 1, 2026; projects that used the API between November 2025 and April 2026 keep their previous quotas, and projects created on or after May 1, 2026 get the new quotas.

claims.claim: Gmail filters are created through the users.settings.filters REST resource, whose Filter resource carries matching criteria and an action. Page: https://developers.google.com/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.settings.filters
claims.raw_snippet: Resource definition for Gmail filters. Filters apply to specific messages instead of an entire email thread.

claims.claim: Gmail's bulk-sender requirements took effect February 1, 2024 for senders of more than 5,000 messages per day to Gmail accounts. Page: https://support.google.com/a/answer/81126
claims.raw_snippet: Starting February 1, 2024, email senders who send more than 5,000 messages per day to Gmail accounts must meet the requirements in this section.

claims.claim: Gmail requires bulk senders to keep the spam complaint rate below 0.1% (written 0.10% by Google) and never reach 0.3% (0.30%).
claims.raw_snippet: below 0.10% and avoid ever reaching a spam rate of 0.30% or higher.

claims.claim: Gmail's one-click unsubscribe requires BOTH the List-Unsubscribe-Post: List-Unsubscribe=One-Click header and a List-Unsubscribe header; neither alone is enough.

claims.raw_snippet: Starting November 2025, Gmail is ramping up its enforcement on non-compliant traffic. Messages that fail to meet the email sender requirements will experience disruptions, including temporary and permanent rejections.

claims.claim: Under Section 30A of Israel's Communications Law a court may award damages without proof of harm of up to 1,000 NIS per message sent. Because they are cumulative, a 500-recipient blast can reach 500,000 NIS.
claims.raw_snippet: פיצויים שאינם תלויים בנזק, בסכום שלא יעלה על 1,000 ₪ בגין כל הודעה ששלח המפרסם לנמען

claims.claim: The Ministry of Communications FAQ states the criminal fine for breaching Section 30A(b)/(c) is up to 202,000 ₪ (and up to 67,300 ₪ for breaching 30A(e)). CAUTION: SKILL.md and SKILL_HE.md state 226,000 NIS; no reachable source was found for 226,000 NIS, so that figure should be corrected to the sourced 202,000 ₪ or re-sourced. The skill also cites https://www.kolzchut.org.il/he/פיצוי_בגין_משלוח_דברי_פרסומת_ללא_הסכמה_של_הנמען_(חוק_הספאם), which returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients and could not be read.
claims.raw_snippet: הפרת האיסור שבסעיף 30א(ב) או (ג) לחוק מהווה עבירה פלילית שדינה קנס של עד 202,000 ₪.

claims.claim: A marketing message under Section 30A must state that it is an advertisement with the word פרסומת at the start (in the subject line for email), the advertiser's name, address and contact details, and the recipient's right to send an opt-out notice with a simple way to do so.
claims.raw_snippet: על המילה \"פרסומת\" להופיע בתחילת דבר הפרסומת, ואם דבר הפרסומת משוגר באמצעות הודעה אלקטרונית – בכותרת ההודעה

claims.claim: Section 30A carves out messages to someone who gave their details during a purchase or negotiation, was told the details would be used for advertising, was given a chance to refuse and did not, where the advertisement concerns a similar product or service.
claims.raw_snippet: דבר הפרסומת מתייחס למוצר או לשירות מסוג דומה למוצר או לשירות האמורים לעיל.
